rules: Plain, simple English. Sentences under ~25 words where possible.
No buzzwords (revolutionize, game-changing, leverage), no hype adjectives (ultimate, amazing, incredible).
No exaggerated claims — never promise 'boost grades 100%' or 'guaranteed A+'.
No keyword stuffing — write for a student reading it, not a keyword counter.
Direct second person ('you') speaking to a student.
Active voice. One idea per paragraph.
Cite limitations honestly — never invent Nomi features that don't exist.
When comparing, always acknowledge competitor strengths. Prefer 'Choose X if…, Choose Nomi if…' over claiming Nomi is universally better.
Never invent statistics, pricing, customer reviews, research papers, or study results. If uncertain, omit.
fillerPhrases: at the end of the day
